Submissions
Submit from your
build page.
No separate form. The private link you got when you registered is your submission. Open it during the build window, add your repo, demo, and posts, then mark it ready before Sep 10, 23:59 UTC.
build window: Sep 1 to Sep 10
What a finished submission includes
Four things. Add them to your build page and marking it ready takes five minutes.
✓
Public repo
Clean commits and a README with complete setup and run instructions.
✓
2 to 5 minute demo
Show the problem, the product, how it works, and a fresh session recalling earlier state.
✓
Team & partner stacks
Name the builders and every Base or Virtuals stack used.
✓
Memory implementation note
Explain what your agent persists, recalls, and uses to make decisions.
One rubric · one leaderboard
How judging works
Projects clear a pass/fail gate, then score against four weighted criteria. A genuine PMF bonus adds up to 10, and verified Base and Virtuals stacks then apply the multiplier.
